concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it must complete before T002 and subsequent tasks that consume the downloaded dataset. This creates an implicit ordering requirement, violating the `[P]` parallel‑safety contract.

Task T002 is also marked `[P]` yet it depends on the output of T001 (raw data). The producer‑consumer relationship means it cannot be safely run in parallel with T001, breaching the `[P]` safety guarantee.
Task T003 carries the `[P]` tag but requires the CSV produced by T002. The ordering dependency makes it non‑parallel‑safe.
Task T004 is `[P]` yet consumes both the normalized CSV from T002 and inferred intents from T003, establishing a required execution order that conflicts with the parallel‑safe annotation.
